findings.title: Test statistics leak into augmentation search
findings.quote:
for aug in candidates:
    val_acc = evaluate(model, test_loader, aug)
    scores[aug] = val_acc
best_aug = max(candidates, key=lambda aug: scores[aug])
return best_aug
findings.claim: The augmentation is selected on the test split.
findings.resolution: Select the augmentation on a validation split.
